name: HTTP-style router with precedence and middleware chaining
instruction: Implement the router in router.js (CommonJS, no dependencies). API: createRouter() returns {add, use, dispatch}. add(method, pattern, handler) registers a route; pattern segments are static ('/users/list'), params (':id' — captured into params by name), or a trailing wildcard ('*' — matches one or more remaining segments, captured as params.wild, the remaining path joined with '/'). use(fn) appends middleware. dispatch(method, path) runs middleware in registration order — each is fn(ctx, next) and must call next() to continue; if a middleware returns without calling next(), dispatch stops and returns {status:0, body:null, params:{}} with ctx.halted true semantics folded in (status 0). After middleware, route matching: the MOST SPECIFIC route wins — static segments beat params, params beat wildcard, compared left-to-right segment by segment. If a path matches a pattern registered for a DIFFERENT method (and no pattern matches for the requested method), return {status:405, body:null, params:{}}. If nothing matches at all, {status:404, body:null, params:{}}. On a match, call handler(params) and return {status:200, body:<handler return>, params}. Paths and patterns always start with '/'; no query strings; empty segments never occur.
verifyCmd: node -e "const {createRouter}=require('./router.js');function mk(){return createRouter()}let r=mk();r.add('GET','/a/:x/c',p=>'P'+p.x);r.add('GET','/a/b/c',()=>'S');r.add('GET','/a/*',p=>'W:'+p.wild);let d=r.dispatch('GET','/a/b/c');if(d.body!=='S'){console.error('static beats param');process.exit(1)}d=r.dispatch('GET','/a/z/c');if(d.body!=='Pz'){console.error('param match');process.exit(1)}d=r.dispatch('GET','/a/q/r/s');if(d.body!=='W:q/r/s'){console.error('wildcard capture, got',d.body);process.exit(1)}r=mk();r.add('POST','/only/post',()=>'p');d=r.dispatch('GET','/only/post');if(d.status!==405){console.error('405 expected, got',d.status);process.exit(1)}d=r.dispatch('DELETE','/none');if(d.status!==404){console.error('404');process.exit(1)}r=mk();const seen=[];r.use((ctx,next)=>{seen.push(1);next()});r.use((ctx,next)=>{seen.push(2);next()});r.add('GET','/m',()=>'m');d=r.dispatch('GET','/m');if(d.status!==200||seen.join('')!=='12'){console.error('mw order');process.exit(1)}r=mk();r.use((ctx,next)=>{});r.add('GET','/h',()=>'h');d=r.dispatch('GET','/h');if(d.status!==0){console.error('halt status 0, got',d.status);process.exit(1)}r=mk();r.add('GET','/p/:a/:b',p=>p.a+'|'+p.b);d=r.dispatch('GET','/p/x/y');if(d.body!=='x|y'){console.error('multi-param');process.exit(1)}if(JSON.stringify(d.params)!==JSON.stringify({a:'x',b:'y'})){console.error('params object');process.exit(1)}r=mk();r.add('GET','/w/*',p=>'w1:'+p.wild);r.add('GET','/w/:x',p=>'w2:'+p.x);d=r.dispatch('GET','/w/solo');if(d.body!=='w2:solo'){console.error('param beats wildcard');process.exit(1)}console.log('ok')"
